photo-joiner.name: Photo Joiner
photo-joiner.tagline: One long strip from many photos.
photo-joiner.metaTitle: Photo Joiner - Combine Photos Into One Strip | JaurTools
photo-joiner.metaDescription: Merge multiple photos into one long vertical or horizontal strip with spacing control. Free, in-browser.
photo-joiner.keywords: combine images, merge photos online, join images vertically, stitch photos together free
photo-joiner.quickAnswer: Upload 2 or more photos and choose vertical stacking or a horizontal row. In vertical mode every photo scales to the same width: two 800 x 600 photos with a 16 px gap produce one 800 x 1216 image (600 + 16 + 600). Set the gap and background color, then download the merged PNG.
keyFacts: Two directions: vertical stack (tall strip) or horizontal row (wide banner).
All photos scale to match the first photo's width (vertical) or height (horizontal).
Aspect ratio is always preserved — photos scale, never stretch.
Gap from 0 to 100 px separates photos; background color fills the gaps.
Photos of different sizes align cleanly because each is scaled to the shared edge.
Output PNG keeps every photo's detail at the merged size.
howTo: Upload 2 or more photos in the order you want them.
Choose vertical stacking or a horizontal row.
Drag the gap slider and pick a background color.
Check the live preview and the final output size.
Click Download to save the combined image as PNG.
photo-joiner.formula:
Vertical: outWidth = width of first photo.
scaledHeight(i) = photoHeight(i) x (outWidth / photoWidth(i)).
outHeight = sum(scaledHeight) + gap x (n - 1).
Horizontal mirrors this with heights. Example: two 800x600, gap 16 -> 800 x 1216.
photo-joiner.workedExample:
Two photos 800 x 600, vertical, gap 16:
1. outWidth = 800 (first photo's width).
2. Photo 1 scaled height: 600 x (800/800) = 600.
3. Photo 2 scaled height: 600 x (800/800) = 600.
4. outHeight = 600 + 16 + 600 = 1216.
5. Result: one 800 x 1216 PNG — both photos full-width, 16 px gap between them.
benefits: Build screenshot walkthroughs and tutorials as one scrollable image.
Before/after comparisons stacked in a single shareable file.
Panorama-style banners from multiple shots without editing skills.
Consistent widths make the strip look professionally assembled.
No uploads — long personal screenshot threads stay private.
limitations: Photos scale to the first photo's edge — mixed sizes lose some resolution.
No overlap or blending between photos; edges are hard cuts with gaps.
Very long strips (10+ tall photos) create huge files that some apps reject.
Order follows upload order and cannot be rearranged inside the tool.
photo-joiner.privacyNote: This tool runs 100% in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faqs.q: How many images can I combine?
faqs.a: Up to 20. Beyond that the output gets enormous and slow. For very long screenshot threads, combine in two batches: merge the first 10, download, then combine that result with the rest.

faqs.q: Will photos with different sizes look okay?
faqs.a: Yes. Each photo scales to the shared edge (width in vertical mode) while keeping its aspect ratio, so everything aligns in a clean strip. Smaller photos are upscaled to match, which can soften them slightly.

faqs.q: Can I remove the gap between photos?
faqs.a: Yes — set the gap to 0 and photos touch edge to edge with no background showing. A small gap of 8 to 16 px usually reads cleaner for tutorial strips.

faqs.q: Vertical or horizontal — which should I pick?
faqs.a: Vertical for phone screenshots, tutorials, and chat threads (they scroll naturally). Horizontal for panoramas, banner images, and side-by-side comparisons.
It depends on your photos: width equals the first photo's width (vertical mode), and height is the sum of scaled heights plus gaps. The preview shows the exact final dimensions before you download.

faqs.q: Are my photos uploaded to a server?
faqs.a: No. Merging happens on a canvas in your browser. Your photos never leave your device.
